changelog: Voiceovers tightened to fit scene durations (v1 ran ~40s of VO in a 32s timeline).
Hook and lower-thirds reframed as allegations (आरोप) — the reel names a real person.
AI prompts no longer generate a fake 'authentic' email; use the sourced screenshot or a generic blurred UI.
Added per-scene start/end timestamps, an AI-content disclosure flag and a source-verification checklist.

safe_zone.note: Keep text out of the Reels/Shorts UI overlay zones.

compliance.framing: allegation — do not state as established fact
verify_before_publish: Primary source for the email text (screenshot / complaint copy / credible outlet report).
Exact wording of both quoted phrases matches the source.
Name and designation of the professor and the complainant.
Department's reported response ('apology given, matter closed') is attributable to a source.
Whether the professor has responded publicly — add one line if so (fairness).
